 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Brighton are on an absolute high early in the 2026/27 campaign following a flying start.
 The Seagulls had the chance to move up to second in the Premier League table ahead of Sunday's encounter against Brentford.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement And the Sussex outfit got off to the perfect start as Diego Gomez, who scored from the halfway line against Palace in October, rifled in another absolute cracker from 25 yards out.
 It was certainly a strike for the highlight reel and once again highlighted Brighton's knack for scoring long-range goals this season.
 Brighton's chances of securing a seventh league win of the season improved further before half-time when Brentford's Igor Thiago was sent off for violent conduct.
